mapper.sql: o.id AS order_id, o.campaign_id, o.user_id, c.name AS campaign_name, o.status, v.id AS voucher_id, o.expires_at, o.created_at, o.completed_at
fulfillment_orders o JOIN campaigns c ON c.id=o.campaign_id LEFT JOIN user_vouchers v ON v.order_id=o.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_orders(request_no,campaign_id,user_id,fulfillment_mode,supplier_id,product_code, status,revision,expires_at,created_at,request_fingerprint,idempotency_deadline_at,contract_version,subject_ref,job_state) VALUES(#{requestNo},#{campaignId},#{userId},#{fulfillmentMode},#{supplierId},#{productCode}, 'PENDING',0,#{expiresAt},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),#{requestFingerprint},#{idempotencyDeadlineAt},#{contractVersion},#{subjectRef}, CASE WHEN #{fulfillmentMode}='SUPPLIER' THEN 'WAITING_EVENT' ELSE 'DONE' END)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fulfillment_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM WHERE o.campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND o.user_id=#{userId}
SELECT FROM WHERE o.id=#{id} AND o.user_id=#{userId}
SELECT FROM WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND o.id>#{afterId} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_orders SET status='FULFILLED',revision=revision+1,completed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','UNKNOWN')
